text: On mo rewi wonndude e Alla reweteeɗo goo hara o maraa hujja jojjiɗugol makko e dewal ngal (ko ɗum woni fiyaake kala rewaaɗo tanaa Alla) anndu pellet, njoɓdi golle makko bonɗe ɗen no ka Joomi makko Senaande wonanii Mo, ko Kanko woni On yoɓirayƊo mo ɗum Leptugol mo, pellet, Kanko O malnirtaa heeferɓe ɓen heɓugol ko ɓe ɗaɓɓata kon, wanah daɗugol ko ɓe hulata kon.
